تزدجروا (form VIII)
# تَزْدَجِرُوا (tazdajirū) /taz.da.d͡ʒi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# تُزْدَجَرُوا (tuzdajarū) /tuz.da.d͡ʒa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
